hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/lake-anna ('sites that can be reserved specifically with and without water and electric hookups', 'Accepts outlets for 20, 30 and 50-amp current', 'E/W - Electric and water hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 23 no-hookup (STD) and 23 electric/water sites, both for tents, pop-ups and RVs up to 60 ft (tents on a 20 x 25 ft pad). Two vehicles per site in addition to the camping unit.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/lake-anna ('Total sites of each type : STD, 23; E/W, 23', 'STD - No hookups, various equipment (tents, popups. RVs) up to 60 feet', 'E/W - ... RVs) up to 60 feet'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Central bathhouses with hot showers; coin laundry in the south loop bathhouse (March 1 through November). Dump station and camp store/gift shop are in the park's amenity list. Generators are not permitted.

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/lake-anna ('centrally located restrooms with hot showers', 'Coin-operated laundry in south loop campground bathhouse', At a Glance: 'Camp Store/Gift Shop ... Dump Station ... Showers', 'GENERATORS ARE NOT PERMITTED'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Every site can be reserved specifically; book online or at 1-800-933-PARK (option 5). Check-in 4 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.; after-hours reservation information is posted outside the contact station.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/lake-anna ('To reserve overnight facilities, call 1-800-933-PARK and select option 5 or book online', 'sites that can be reserved specifically', check-in/out), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed the season (first Friday in March to first Monday in December, already manual) and that the $32 no-hookup base site takes RVs up to 60 ft; fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12. Added 50-amp electric with water, 46 sites to 60 ft, showers/laundry/dump/camp store. Not stated: sewer, pull-throughs, booking window/cutoff for this park (left inherited), fcfs.
